title: Booking Transaction Fee Card for the Corporate Travel Programmes
content:
The transaction fee for a booking made through a Corporate Travel Programme is published per tier, for the channel the booking was made through and the product it was made for.

The columns below carry the six tiers of the Corporate Travel Programmes in rank order: the Business Starter Programme, the Business Team Programme, the Business Pro Programme, the Business Enterprise Programme, the Business Enterprise Plus Programme and the Business Global Programme.

|  | Starter | Team | Pro | Enterprise | Enterprise Plus | Global |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Booking made in the online tool | 7.50 USD | 6.50 USD | 5.50 USD | 4.50 USD | 3.50 USD | 2.50 USD |
| Booking made through the service desk | 39.00 USD | 34.00 USD | 29.00 USD | 25.00 USD | 21.00 USD | 18.00 USD |
| Booking made outside business hours | 65.00 USD | 59.00 USD | 52.00 USD | 45.00 USD | 39.00 USD | 32.00 USD |
| Reworking an issued ticket | 29.00 USD | 25.00 USD | 22.00 USD | 18.00 USD | 15.00 USD | 12.00 USD |
| Processing a refund | 29.00 USD | 25.00 USD | 22.00 USD | 18.00 USD | 15.00 USD | 12.00 USD |
| Hotel booking | 6.00 USD | 5.25 USD | 4.50 USD | 3.75 USD | 3.00 USD | 2.25 USD |
| Car rental booking | 5.00 USD | 4.50 USD | 4.00 USD | 3.50 USD | 3.00 USD | 2.25 USD |
| Rail booking | 6.50 USD | 5.75 USD | 5.00 USD | 4.25 USD | 3.50 USD | 2.75 USD |

## Notes to the card

1. Every figure on this card falls as the tier rises. The online tool figure runs from 7.50 USD on the Business Starter Programme down to 2.50 USD on the Business Global Programme; the service desk figure runs from 39.00 USD down to 18.00 USD, and the figure for a booking made outside business hours from 65.00 USD down to 32.00 USD.
2. Reworking an issued ticket and processing a refund carry the same published figure at every tier: 29.00 USD on the Business Starter Programme, 25.00 USD on the Business Team Programme, 22.00 USD on the Business Pro Programme, 18.00 USD on the Business Enterprise Programme, 15.00 USD on the Business Enterprise Plus Programme and 12.00 USD on the Business Global Programme.
3. The hotel, car rental and rail figures are published separately for each product: hotel from 6.00 USD down through 5.25 USD, 4.50 USD, 3.75 USD and 3.00 USD to 2.25 USD; car rental from 5.00 USD down through 4.50 USD, 4.00 USD, 3.50 USD and 3.00 USD to 2.25 USD; rail from 6.50 USD down through 5.75 USD, 5.00 USD, 4.25 USD and 3.50 USD to 2.75 USD.
